engines.title: Market
engines.description: Simulates households choosing whether and where to buy each day while sellers set prices, promotions and subscriptions (repricing on demand by default).

engines.title: Council
engines.description: Simulates a panel giving sealed probability forecasts, deliberating and forecasting again; scores the final forecasts (Brier) once the outcome is supplied and measures consensus by their spread.

engines.title: Dispute
engines.description: Simulates two sides offering, objecting to and cross-examining evidence before a judge; jurors weigh the total strength of what was admitted and vote on liability and damages.

engines.title: Exchange
engines.description: Simulates configurable trading among human participants across assets, market structures, and information conditions.

engines.title: Legislature
engines.description: Simulates a legislative body moving, seconding, debating, amending and voting on a measure; each floor speech pulls other members' stances toward the speaker's, and the outcome is passed, rejected, or the status quo when nothing comes to a vote.

engines.title: Contest
engines.description: Simulates participants submitting each round while a host judge scores them on a weighted rubric; the single top scorer wins, a rubric tie goes to the stronger hidden performance (skill plus luck), and without a judge skill and luck decide and the run says so.

engines.title: Deliberation
engines.description: Simulates people exchanging reasons, proposing and amending a conclusion, and voting; each speech pulls listeners' stances toward the speaker's, and the outcome is passed, rejected, or the status quo when nothing comes to a vote.

engines.title: Negotiation
engines.description: Simulates two parties exchanging complete multi-issue offers and counteroffers before a deadline; nobody can offer or accept terms worth less to them than their private walk-away value, and each party's surplus is reported.

engines.title: Population
engines.description: Runs sampled people through a shared situation: each responds independently from their inclination, blurred by their uncertainty, and the responses are aggregated.

engines.title: Network
engines.description: Simulates an idea spreading over explicit ties: each round every adopter may convince each contact with a chance of trust times receptivity, so trust and time drive adoption.

engines.title: Matching
engines.description: Simulates two-sided matching: applicants and selectors privately rank each other and deferred acceptance makes a stable match within each selector's capacity.

engines.title: Strategy
engines.description: Simulates repeated cooperate-or-compete choices among any number of players under a configurable payoff matrix; coded players follow classic strategies (tit for tat, grim trigger, always cooperate or compete, random) with occasional mistakes, and a tie names no winner.
